'''SW-0608''' was a [[Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle|''Zeta''-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle]] stolen from the [[Galactic Empire]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and used by the squad [[Rogue One]] during the [[Battle of Scarif]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

==History==
[[File:Imperial_Cargo_Shuttle_Trailer_2.jpg|left|thumb|SW-0608 explodes during the Battle of Scarif]]
Initially assigned to the [[Eadu Flight Station]], it was [[Mission to Eadu|stolen]] by [[Bodhi Rook]]. The reprogrammed [[KX-series security droid]] [[K-2SO]] assisted Rook to pilot SW-0608 during the rescue of [[Jyn Erso]], [[Baze Malbus]], [[Chirrut Îmwe]], and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] from the [[Eadu Energy Conversion Laboratory|Research station]] and return them to the [[Great Temple|Rebel base]] on [[Yavin 4]]. Following Jyn's failed attempt to persuade the Rebel Alliance to attack [[Scarif]] and retrieve the [[Death Star plans]], it was stolen again by Rook and K-2S0 to transport Erso & Andor's infiltration team to the surface of Scarif.<ref name="Rogue One" />

The shuttle was destroyed during the Battle of Scarif by a [[Coastal defender stormtrooper|shoretrooper]] who threw a [[grenade]] into the ship's hangar, killing Bodhi Rook.<ref name="Rogue One" />

==Behind the scenes==
The significance of the designation SW-0608 was confirmed by ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' screenwriter [[Chris Weitz]] when asked the question on Twitter. "SW" are the initials of Weitz's son Sebastian Weitz, whose birthday is the 8th June.<ref name="twitter">{{Twitter|chrisweitz|status/1036769665555488768|[[Chris Weitz]]|quote=My son Sebastian's birthday is June 8th|archivefile=File:CargoShuttleNamesake.png|archiveurl=https://archive.is/WUvTF}}</ref>
